summary: Added native automatic standard-node sizing from initial available width, intrinsic word minimums and the previous measured diagram width. Host-only resize preserves width; content changes converge measured layout; remount reinitializes width. Explicit widths/caps and custom/legacy behavior take priority.
current_implementation: SteyTableOfContents now provides compound title/list/item/group widgets and a controller for native scrolling, quiet-period pinning and Web hashchange. The Japanese demo includes deep links, nested selection and native scrolling. Full parity certification and the later upstream changes remain outstanding. SteyDropdownMenu adds nested children, group/label/separator, controlled checkbox/radio items, icon slots, popup-local auto-inset, submenu offsets, focus/typeahead and native menu roles against 1846759. SteyButton applies text lift, icon padding, content-aware spacing and default icon sizing; SteySidebarMenuSub/Item/Button provide native hierarchy lists and a noninteractive, unannounced guide. The Sidebar resize handle follows the upstream hidden/sm:block breakpoint at 640 CSS pixels. SteyLayerDialog now has independent desktop/mobile layered surfaces, four size variants, top/center alignment, typed Action/Actions/Primary, split menus, alert/pending control, native modal roles and sticky title/footer with condensed descriptions. SteyButtonGroup joins logical outside corners and one-pixel seams without changing Tab/semantics order. SteyFlowAnchor measures start/end/both render boxes in diagram coordinates, including margins and transforms; Flow uses rounded 2px connector paths and native list/item semantics without exposing technical IDs. Primary/destructive SteyButton surfaces now include the upstream one-pixel inset highlight, retained inside joined groups. SteyFlow.composed, SteyFlowList and SteyFlowParallel add native content measurement in the layout pass, structural edge rules, horizontal/vertical orientation, center/end alignment and natural canvas dimensions. Flow canvas replaces legacy zoom with bounded background mouse/touch/trackpad panning at scale 1, independent wheel deltas, resize clamping, hover scrollbar indicators and overflow notifications; node gestures are excluded and semantic scrolling is available. SteyFlowNode.maxWidth caps outer width including padding, takes priority over explicit/global width, preserves short natural content and measures wrapped height without intrinsic APIs. The Japanese demo adjusts caps to host width and exercises content/orientation changes. Default-styled uncapped composed nodes now track initial available/previous containing width, preferred/min-content sizes and measured positions. Batched convergence continues across frames, host-only resize preserves history and a changed key remounts measurement. autoWidth false retains native natural sizing; custom and unsupported intrinsic children keep the prior measurement path.
